en.lead: I'm a full-stack developer. For several years I have programmed, coordinated and supervised projects of many kinds, and I like to follow a project through its whole life, from conception to implementation. I pay close attention to detail and can run several projects at once. I work closely with clients and teammates, focused on what the client needs and on the project's success.
en.body: I work with PHP and Laravel, GraphQL and REST APIs, React and Next.js, Node.js and NestJS, and Python, with MySQL and PostgreSQL databases, plus Jira and AWS. I manage my own work on independent projects and collaborate well in teams.
en.technologies: PHP, Laravel, GraphQL, REST APIs, React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, Python, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Jira, AWS
